display_name: Derived evidence index (producer records and build inputs)

optional: accepted publications of every evidence_index_enrichment.PROFILES producer present in the run
derived-text-manifest.json listed by an included producer

applicability: every run with an accepted 02-evidence-index, after the derived-record producers are terminal

text_max_files.description: Most text documents (generated headers, converted documents) chunked; the rest are listed with status over-file-count and a gap.
text_max_files.scale: Grows with generated headers per unit (02-native-build caps 256 per unit) and converted documents.

text_max_file_bytes.description: Largest text document chunked; larger ones are listed with a gap.

text_max_total_bytes.description: Total text bytes chunked; documents beyond it are listed with a gap.
text_max_total_bytes.scale: Grows with the converted document set.

text_max_line_chars.description: Longest line in a chunked text document; a longer line excludes the document with a gap.

build_records_max.description: Most build-dependencies records indexed across units; the rest are counted in a gap.
build_records_max.scale: Grows with headers and libraries a build consumes (02-native-build caps 8192 files per unit).
